children: The Saudi Arabia-listed Ayyan Investment Company has secured a 150 million riyals ($40 million) Shariah-compliant revolving loan facility with Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB) with a five-year tenor.
The Tawarruq transaction (reverse Murabaha) has been conducted with a promissory note, with Ayyan pledging a part of its portfolio assets.

Ayyan, which manages projects in the healthcare, manufacturing, and real estate sectors, said in a bourse filing the capital will help expand the company’s investments in equity instruments, whether listed on the Saudi market or through ownership stakes in unlisted companies.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Saudi’s Ayyan Investment secures $40mln Islamic loan facility with SAB
